issue.title: Implement Background Sync Notification with Upload Progress
issue.body:
When a translator leaves the app while a sync is running, there is no indication that upload activity is continuing. The background sync notification surfaces live progress in the system notification shade — a chapter count that updates as each upload finishes and a tap-through to the Sync page for full detail. On Android, the notification also serves as the mechanism that keeps the foreground sync service alive while the app is closed.

## Functional Requirements

### Notification Trigger

- Show a persistent, non-dismissible system notification when sync is running in the background.
- On Android, implement as a foreground service notification so the sync process survives while the app is closed.
- On iOS, show the notification only while the app is active or recently backgrounded; iOS background sync is best-effort and the notification is not guaranteed to fire when the app is fully closed.
- Clear the notification automatically when sync completes, is paused, or is cancelled.

### Notification Content

- Title: "Uploading your recordings"
- Body: "X of Y chapters uploaded", where X is the count of completed chapter uploads and Y is the total chapter count queued at the start of the sync session.
- Update the body count each time a chapter upload completes.
- Include no inline actions on the notification.

### Tap Behavior

- Tapping the notification navigates the user to the Sync page.

> **Note:** I can create a mockup if that is needed, but I figured you would go with the standard notification style for each OS.
> **Note:** iOS background sync runs under BGTaskScheduler and is best-effort — the system may delay or skip background execution when the app is fully closed. The notification fires reliably only while the app is foregrounded or recently backgrounded. Do not make promises about iOS background sync in any UI copy.

---

## Engineering context
*(Added for implementation readiness. Product requirements above remain the source of truth.)*

### Product intent (summary)
While upload sync runs in the background, show a persistent Android notification with chapter progress that opens the Sync page; use a foreground service so work continues when the app is backgrounded.

### Proposed technical approach
1. **Android-only** (repo policy): implement foreground-service notification; treat product iOS notes as **N/A** — do not add iOS background sync.
2. Subscribe to #150 orchestrator session progress (completed/total chapters at session start).
3. Use Expo notifications + Android foreground service patterns compatible with CNG (`app.config.ts` plugins; regenerate `android/` via `npm run prebuild` — do not commit `android/`).
4. Notification content: title/body per product; update on each chapter completion; no inline actions.
5. Tap → navigate to `Sync` screen (deep link / notification response handler).
6. Clear on complete, pause, or cancel.

### Systems / modules / anchors
- Engine events: extend `src/services/syncEvents.ts` or orchestrator emitters from #150
- Nav: `RootStackParamList.Sync`, `AppNavigator.tsx`
- Config plugins: `app.config.ts` (add notifications / FG service as required by chosen library)
- No notification stack on `main` today

### Implementation steps
1. Select library approach via Expo SDK 56 docs (authenticate Expo MCP when implementing).
2. Add config plugin + notification channel for sync.
3. Start FG notification when #150 enters syncing and app is backgrounded (or always while syncing — see Open questions).
4. Update “X of Y chapters uploaded”.
5. Handle notification tap → Sync.
6. Clear on terminal/paused states.
7. Tests with mocked notifications module; Android device QA mandatory.

### Dependencies & prerequisites
- **In-repo:** #150 (progress events), #149 (Sync page to open). Related #151.
- **External:** None for notification chrome; upload success still needs #100/#102.

### Edge cases & failure states
- App process death: FG service behavior per Android version — document minimum SDK assumptions.
- Multiple sessions: one notification id; replace content, do not stack.
- Tap when logged out: route safely to auth/home.
- Permission denied (Android 13+ notification permission): degrade without crashing; sync may still run — clarify with product if upload should require permission.

### Testing & verification
- Unit: mapping of engine events → notification content / clear.
- **Human Android device QA required** (notifications + foreground service) before ready-for-review per AGENTS.md.
- Gates: format → lint → typecheck → test; `npm run doctor` if native plugins change.

### Analytics / observability / migrations
- Config plugin / prebuild impact only; no SQLite migration.
- Log notification start/update/clear.

### Assumptions
- iOS requirements in the product text are ignored for this Android-only app.
- Y is fixed at session start even if new pending chapters appear mid-session (product text); if engine appends chapters, confirm whether Y grows.

### Open questions
1. Show notification only when app backgrounded, or whenever syncing (including foreground)?
2. Android 13+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS: block sync until granted, or sync without notification?
3. Does pause clear the notification immediately (product says yes)?

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Persistent non-dismissible (ongoing) notification while background sync is running on Android.
- [ ] Implemented as foreground-service notification so upload can continue while the app is backgrounded.
- [ ] Title/body match spec; body updates as chapters complete.
- [ ] No inline notification actions.
- [ ] Tap opens Sync page.
- [ ] Notification clears on complete, pause, or cancel.
- [ ] No iOS-specific implementation added.
- [ ] Android device QA results recorded on the PR.

## API readiness note (board audit — refreshed)

**Why the API is not complete for this ticket**

Notification chrome itself needs **no new fluent-api endpoints**. End-to-end DevQA of “X of Y chapters uploaded” against a real backend still depends on a **deployed verse-audio upload API**, which is not on `main`.

### What exists today (fluent-api `main` @ `28f9bdb`)

- No verse-audio routes on `main`.
- R2 infrastructure for USFM export (#212) is on `main` but does not upload translator recordings.
- Open [fluent-api PR #224](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/224) (`PUT/GET/DELETE /verse-audio/...`, R2 audio bucket, `uploadedBy` from bearer) — **unmerged**; competing [PR #188](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/188).

### What is missing

1. Merged + deployed recording upload so chapter upload completion events reflect real server success (not only local orchestrator progress).
2. Stable error contract (401/403/404/413/503) as frozen in mobile `docs/guides/recordings-sync-contract.md` against #224.

### What needs to be done

1. fluent-api: merge/deploy #224 (or chosen API) and publish base URL/env for mobile DevQA.
2. Mobile #152: implement FG notification + Sync deep link against #150 orchestrator progress; use mocked/orchestrator-local progress until upload API is live.
3. Do not block notification UI on API — block only “live upload DevQA” claims.

Checked against fluent-api `main` @ `28f9bdb` (2026-08-06). Prior audit was `3ef4025` (2026-07-31).
